    u_3} : {C : Type u_3} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_3} C] →
    [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.CartesianMonoidalCategory.{u_2, u_3} C inst] →
      (X : C) →
        (F :
            @CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_2, u_1, u_3, u_1 + 1} (Opposite.{u_3 + 1} C)
              (@CategoryTheory.Category.opposite.{u_2, u_3} C inst) GrpCat.{u_1} GrpCat.instCategory.{u_1}) →
          @CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy.{u_1, u_2, u_3} C inst
              (@CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_2, u_1, u_1, u_3, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} (Opposite.{u_3 + 1} C)
                (@CategoryTheory.Category.opposite.{u_2, u_3} C inst) GrpCat.{u_1} GrpCat.instCategory.{u_1} (Type u_1)
                CategoryTheory.types.{u_1} F
                (@CategoryTheory.forget.{u_1, u_1, u_1 + 1, u_1} GrpCat.{u_1} GrpCat.instCategory.{u_1}
                  (fun x1 x2 =>
                    @MonoidHom.{u_1, u_1} (↑x1) (↑x2)
                      (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_1} (↑x1)
                        (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_1} (↑x1)
                          (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_1} (↑x1) (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_1} (↑x1) x1.str))))
                      (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_1} (↑x2)
                        (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_1} (↑x2)
                          (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_1} (↑x2) (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_1} (↑x2) x2.str)))))
                  GrpCat.carrier.{u_1}
                  (fun X Y =>
                    @MonoidHom.instFunLike.{u_1, u_1} (↑X) (↑Y)
                      (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_1} (↑X)
                        ((fun X =>
                            @Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_1} (↑X)
                              (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_1} (↑X) (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_1} (↑X) X.str)))
                          X))
                      (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_1} (↑Y)
                        (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_1} (↑Y)
                          (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_1} (↑Y) (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_1} (↑Y) Y.str)))))
                  GrpCat.instConcreteCategoryMonoidHomCarrier.{u_1}))
              X →
            @CategoryTheory.GrpObj.{u_2, u_3} C inst inst_1 X
